MATERIAL BRIEF — Ironwood:
Palette: Deep brown-black heartwood with narrow copper-brown grain lines.
Value: Dark, weighty values with small satin highlights.
Surface/wear: Exceptionally dense closed grain, hard polished ridges, minor impact whitening, few dents.
Construction: Thick load-bearing limbs and shafts, precise carved facets, robust collars, inset grips.
Supernatural behavior: Only an uncanny sense of weight and hardness; no glow.
Neutral secondary materials: Steel, dark leather, black cord, and muted bronze.
Neighbor distinction: Darker, denser, and more architectural than Yew; less alive and expressive than Heartwood.



STYLE/OUTPUT: premium realistic-painterly dark fantasy equipment inventory art; grounded construction; honest material response; cold key light, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal studio ground with restrained floor plane. One fully visible object centered on a 1024×1024 portrait-or-square canvas, about 8% margin and never below 5%; readable at 128px.
